column5: The NIST heading prints the identifier UNS N107718. That source spelling is retained here without normalizing it into a qualified UNS grade. The source family is Inconel 718, with no declared aging schedule; it is separate from the existing aged Special Metals profile. The thermal-conductivity data span 6-275 K, narrower than the 4-300 K equation range. No heat capacity or density is supplied. Engineering-reference-model=1 explicitly accepts compiled source fits and authored linear interpolation. Product form, complete processing, pressure, orientation and matched specimens remain unknown unless named. Scalar conductivity does not establish isotropy. No density, phase-change, loss, fracture or strength law is added.

Published log10(y)=sum(a_i*log10(T)^i); coefficients a onward=-8.28921,39.4470,-83.4353,98.1690,-67.2088,26.7082,-5.7205,0.51115,0; T in K, source scale to stored W/m/K=1. Original data range 6-275 K and equation range 4-300 K. The stored interval 6-275 K stays within both and within the selected branch. NIST reports 2 percent fit error relative to data, not a confidence interval; measurement uncertainty remains unstated. Decimal coefficients evaluated with 60-digit arithmetic, ordinates stored with 16 significant digits. 179 knots use 160 logarithmic intervals plus supported anchors/endpoints. Linear interpolation is an authored approximation. Quarter/midpoint/three-quarter checks observed maximum absolute interpolation difference 0.0003006999429426007 W/m/K and relative difference 0.004760359799701984 percent. These sampled comparisons are not global certified error bounds or source uncertainty.

Published y=sum(a_i*T^i); coefficients a onward=-236.8,-0.2120,0.005497,-0.000006882,0; T in K, source scale to stored 1=0.00001. Original data range 4-300 K and equation range 4-300 K. The stored interval 20.000000000000004-300 K stays within both and within the selected branch. NIST reports 1.1 percent fit error relative to data, not a confidence interval; measurement uncertainty remains unstated. Decimal coefficients evaluated with 60-digit arithmetic, ordinates stored with 16 significant digits. 150 knots use a 2 K grid plus supported anchors/endpoints. Linear interpolation is an authored approximation. Quarter/midpoint/three-quarter checks observed maximum absolute interpolation difference 5.063433999999980e-8 1. These sampled comparisons are not global certified error bounds or source uncertainty. Stored finite strain is (L(T)-L293)/L293, not instantaneous CTE; the original rounded reference-length residual is retained.

The source uses constant -238.87 times 1e-5 below 20 K, and the polynomial strictly above 20 K. The rounded polynomial at that threshold would be -0.00238896256000 whereas the plateau is -0.0023887; their difference is retained, not smoothed. The exact join temperature has no stated branch and is excluded. The two claims end/start at the neighboring representable f64 temperatures on each side; a continuous path across the join refuses. Neither the source datum nor this plateau gives a heat capacity or absolute density.
